notes.title: Developer's Note
notes.content:
Hi, how are you doing on your adventure with Jade?
There will be many people who still feel that it is not enough as a game, so we would like to announce future updates.

1. Battle Reorganization Plan
- Time limit
: A long, meaningless battle is exhausting. Therefore, we will add the appropriate combat time-out function.

- Monster Active Skill
: There are many people who find the fighting style boring. Therefore, we will add the Monster Active skill as an element for players to intervene in combat.

- Jade's Skill
: Jade will be given special skills to improve combat more actively.

2. Farming reform plan
- Improvement of stats
: Currently, Stat Balance is quite uncharacteristic. We will improve it through a steady balance test.

3. Additional Content
- Additional Stage
: The rest of the stage work is currently in progress. We will try to complete the story.

Thank you to those who believe in this game even though it's not enough. I will do my best to develop a better game.

We'll be back with better news.

Thank you.
